m: 1. गुह् cl. 1. P. Ā. गूहति, ˚ते (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 89; impf. अगूहत्, RV. ii, 24, 3; perf. जुगूह, Ragh. xiv; fut. गूहिष्यति, Bhaṭṭ. xvi, 41; aor. अगूहीत्, xv; Subj. 2. sg. घुक्षस् [vi] or Ved. गुहस् [RV. viii, 6, 17]; pr. p. P. गूहत्, iv, 51, 9; Ā. गूहमान, MBh. &c.; Pass. गुह्यमान, RV. iv, 58, 4; VS. ii, 17; aor. गुहमान, RV. iv, 1, 11; Ved. ind.p. गूढ्वी, vii, 80, 2) to cover, conceal, hide, keep secret, RV. &c.: Desid. जुघुक्षति (Pāṇ. vii, 2, 12; 3. du. जुगुक्षतस्, Pada-pāṭha जुघुक्ष्˚) to wish to conceal or hide away, RV. viii, 31, 7.
2. गुह् (only acc. गुहम् and instr. 1. गुहा) f. a hiding-place, RV. i, 67, 6.
a: गुह् — {c1c} U. (गूहति-ते, जुगूह, जुगुहे, अगूहीत्, अगूहिष्ट, अगूढ, अघुक्षत्-त, गूहिष्यति-ते, घोक्ष्यति-ते, गूहितुं, गोढुं, गूढ) 1 To cover, hide, conceal, keep secret; गुह्यं च गूहति गुणान् प्रकटीकरोति Bh. 2. 72; गूहेत्कूर्म इवांगानि Ms. 7. 105; R. 14. 49; Bk. 16. 41. --2 To cover with clothes.

a: गुहा — 1 A cave, cavern, hidingplace; गुहानिबद्धप्रतिशब्ददीर्घं R. 2. 28, 51; धर्मस्य तत्त्वं निहितं गुहायां Mb. --2 Hiding, concealing. --3 A pit, hole in the ground. --4 The heart. --5 Intellect. --Comp. --आहित a. placed in the heart. --चरं Brahman. --मुख a. ‘cave-mouthed,’ widemouthed, open-mouthed. --शयः {1} a mouse. {2} a tiger or lion. {3} the Supreme soul.

k.v: दरी तु कन्दरो वा स्त्री देवखातबिले गुहा। गह्वरं गण्डशैलास्तु च्युताः स्थूलोपला गिरेः॥ दन्तकास्तु बहिस्तिर्यक्प्रदेशान्निर्गता गिरेः।

m: गुह्य mfn. (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 109, Kāś. g. दण्डादि) to be covered or concealed or hidden or kept secret, concealable, private, secret, mysterious, mystical, RV.; AV. &c.
गुह्य m. hypocrisy, L.
a tortoise, L.
N. of Viṣṇu (RTL. p. 106), W.
गुह्य n. a secret, mystery, MBh. (ifc. f(आ). , xiii, 5876), Mn. xii, 117; Bhag. &c.
the pudenda, Suśr.; VarBṛS.; Kathās. ii, 56 (cf. 1. गृह्य) the anus, W.
a: गुह्य — pot. p. 1 To be concealed, covered or kept secret, private; गुह्यं च गूहति Bh. 2. 72. --2 Secret, solitary, retired. --3 Mysterious; Bg. 18. 63. --ह्यः 1 Hypocrisy. --2 An epithet of Viṣṇu. --3 A tortoise. --ह्यं 1 A secret, mystery; मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां Bg. 10. 38; 9. 2; Ms. 12. 117; Pt. 2. 45. --2 A privity, the male or female organ of generation. --3 The anus. --Comp. --गुरुः an epithet of Śiva. --दीपकः the firefly. --निष्यंदः urine. --पुष्पः the Aśvattha tree (‘with concealed blossoms’). --भाषितं {1} secret speech or conversation. {2} a secret. --मयः an epithet of Kārtikeya.

v: strI nityakrma॰ । viSvasAratantrokte devImUrttikAlI Bede tanmantrAdyuktaM tatra yaTA “aTa vakzye maheSAni! vidyAM sarvaPalapradAm । caturvargapradAM sAkzAt mahApAtakanASinIm । sarvasidDipradAM nityAM BaktimuktipradAyinIm । guhyakAlIM mahAvidyAM trElokye cAtidurlaBAm । indrAdi(ra)rUQaM vargAdyaM rativinduviBUzitam (krIM) । triguRaYca tataH kftvA iSAnaYca samudDaret । zazWasvarasamAyuktaM vindunAdakalAnvitam (hUM) । dviguRaYca tataH kftvA ISavarRaM samudDaret । vAmAkzivahnisaMyuktaM nAdavindukalAyutam (hrIM) । tadguhye kAlike pAktvAH cATavA dakziRe vadet । saptavIjaM tataH paScAt trElokyamohinI tviyam” । aTa veti guhye kAlike । dakziRe kAlike” vA

yAntamanuyAnti varArTinaH । sidDacAraRaganDarvvA yakzaguhyakapannagAH ॥”) tasya lokaH piSAcalokAdUrdDvaM ganDarvvalokAdaDaH । yena yena karmmaRA etallokaprAptistaducyate । “tato gacCandadarSAgre hfzwapuzwajanErvftam । pittiRqilEH sTUlavakrErmeGagamBIranisvanEH ॥ lokEraDyuzitaM lokaM SyAmalANgESca lomaSEH । gaRO kaTayataM ke'mI ko lokaH puRyataH kftaH ॥ gaRAvUcatuH । guhyakAnAmayaM lokastvete BuYjate svargasOKyAni devatvamakutoBayAH ॥” iti kASIKaRqe SivaSarmmaRo vEkuRWalokagamane vizRugaRasaMvAdaH ॥ (pakvAnnaviSezaH । tasya pAkaprakAro yaTA, SabdArTacintAmaRiDftapAkaSAstra । “samitAM sarpizA BfzwAM sitAdrAkzAdisamBftAm । elA lavaNgakarpUramarIcaparivAsitAm ॥ kziptvAnyasamitAlambapuwe vezwya Gfte pacet । tataH KaRqe nyaset pakve guhyako'yamudAhftaH ॥” asya guRAstatrEva । yaTA, -- “guhyako bfMhaRo hfdyo vfzyaH pittAnilApahaH । maDuro'tiguruH pAke kiYcit sanDAnakft saraH ॥”)
v: pu॰ gUhanti rakzanti niDiM guha--stvul pfzo॰ yagAgamaH । “niDiM gUhanti ye yakzAste syurguhyakasaMjYakAH iti vyAqiH । guhyaM kutsitaM kAyati kE--Sabde kaH guhyaM gopanIyaM kaM suKaM yezAmiti vA anayoH pakzayoH “SaMsiduhiguhiByoveti” kASikAvacanAt guheH kyap । 1 devayoniBede tallokaprAptikarmaBedAH kASI॰ Ka॰ uktA yaTA “guhyakAnAmayaM lokastvete vEguhyakAH smftAH” “nyAyenopArjya vittAni gUhayanti ca ye Buvi । svamArgagA DanAdyASca SUdraprAyAH kuwumbinaH । saMviBajya ca BoktAraH kroDAsUyAvivarjitAH । na tiTiM nEva vAraYca saMkrAntyAdi na parva ca । nADarmaYca na DarmaYca vidantyete sadAsuKAH । ekameva hi jAnanti kulapUjyohi yo dvijaH । tasmE gAH saMprayacCanti manyante tadvacaH sPuwam । samfdDiBAjohyatrApi tena puRyena guhyakAH । BuYjate svargasOKyAni devatvamakutoBayAH” । 2 pakAnnaBede tatpAkaprakAro yaTA “samitAM sarpizA BfzwAM sitAdrAkzAdisamBftAm । elAlavaNgakarpUramarIcaparivAsitAm । kziptvAnya samitAlambapuwe vezwya Gfte pacet । tataH KaRqe nyaset pakve guhyako'yamudAhftaH । guhyako vfMhaRohfdyo vfzyaH pittAnilApahaH maDuro'tiguruH pAke kiYcit sanDAnakftsaraH” pAkaSA॰
